Scale: the plate looks about 20-22 cm across, so I treated it as a side plate. It spans roughly 440 px, which works out to about 0.048 cm per px, or about 21 cm.

Almonds: I counted about 40. At roughly 1.2 g each, that is about 48 g.

Brussels sprouts: I counted about 10 roasted halves or whole sprouts. At roughly 12 g each, that is about 110 g. Some look like whole small sprouts at 10-15 g, so I'll estimate 100 g.

Melon: I counted about 9 cubes of honeydew or cucumber-like melon. Each cube is about 3 cm on a side, around 20 g, so about 160 g. Some pieces are thinner, so I'll use 150 g.
